# Eyadex

> Eyadex is cloud clinic management software for multi-branch practices, built first for psychiatry and psychology clinics in Kuwait. Arabic first, with full English.

## Who it is for
Owners and medical directors of clinics with one or more branches, starting with mental-health clinics, where patient data is the most sensitive.

## What it does today (the foundation)
- Clinics and their branches (two levels only).
- Users and invitations; each user works in the branches the clinic allows, or all branches.
- Roles and permissions from a clear catalogue (view, add, edit, deactivate), at clinic or branch scope. Default roles: clinic admin, doctor, cashier, technician; clinics can edit them or build their own.
- Basic patient files (no clinical notes yet).
- An append-only audit log, including every time a patient file is opened.
- Nothing is hard-deleted: users, branches and roles are deactivated, patients are archived.
- Every clinic is isolated from every other inside the database itself. The Eyadex platform team has no access to patient data.

## On the roadmap (no dates)
Appointments and scheduling; sessions and doctor notes; medical record; notifications by email, then WhatsApp; finance; a page for each clinic on its own address; an AI assistant.
